races.name: Best Dressed Competitions Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Kilnew Supreme
runners_data.note: Lead runner with recent consistent form for Nicholls but faces stronger opposition than previous efforts and may struggle to dominate class-wise

runners_data.name: Parchment
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 149-day break for Pipe but showed high-class form before absence and benefits from tactical scenario

runners_data.name: Crest Of Stars
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with proven winning form and recent run advantage, carries extra weight but suits the likely pace setup perfectly

runners_data.name: Docteur Romeo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with concerning fade tendency who faces significant class deficit against these opponents

runners_data.name: Warfleet
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with hunter chase background who appears outclassed despite good going conditions

runners_data.name: Royal Rocket
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing bumper promise but weakened badly when stepped up in trip on hurdle debut last time
runners_data.comment: Drops in trip but likely needs more time and experience before showing his best.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some promise in a Chepstow bumper (soft) last month but he weakened markedly upped in trip on hurdle debut there (2m7f, good to soft) since, when running too freely; drop back in trip may suit but likely needs more time and experience before showing his best.

runners_data.name: Winning Paddy
runners_data.note: Prominent tracker with fade concerns returning from long absence for struggling stable connection
runners_data.comment: 1-11 in Irish points; faces a tough task on British/stable debut switching to hurdles.
runners_data.spotlight: 1-11 in Irish points but his recent efforts have been uninspiring back from an absence and he changed hands for £2,000 in March; faces a tough task on stable/rules debut.

races.paceDynamic: Kilnew Supreme will dictate from the front as the sole confirmed leader, setting a sustainable gallop without early pressure. The prominent runners Royal Rocket, Docteur Romeo and Winning Paddy lack the pace or ability to hassle him meaningfully, while hold-up horses Parchment and Crest Of Stars will track from off the pace. This creates a tactical race where the front-runner controls proceedings until the closing stages when the finishers make their moves. This race shape strongly favours horses that can travel and finish, particularly the hold-up performers who can exploit the likely moderate early gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Kilnew Supreme sets modest fractions and the hold-up horses get ideal positioning.
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows Parchment and Crest Of Stars to close strongly, with their superior class telling in the final furlong. Both have proven finishing kicks and benefit most from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Kilnew Supreme gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear approaching the last.
scenarios.body: His Nicholls training and recent consistent form allows him to exploit the lack of early pace pressure and build an unassailable advantage. The hold-up horses are left with too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Royal Rocket or Winning Paddy can track the leader and outstay him.
scenarios.body: The tactical pace suits a horse that can sit handy and have something left, with Royal Rocket's bumper promise potentially translating over hurdles. However, both have shown finishing concerns that make this outcome less likely.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is crawling and multiple horses are still in contention at the last.
scenarios.body: A messy finish where class matters less than position and jumping, potentially allowing an outsider like Docteur Romeo to capitalize on superior positioning. The rhythm breaks down and creates an unexpected outcome.

watchPoints.text: Kilnew Supreme may get too easy a lead early if the prominent runners don't engage, allowing him to control the race completely
Parchment's 149-day absence could leave him short of full fitness despite his superior class on paper
Crest Of Stars carries 166lbs which is significantly more than his rivals and could impact his finishing kick
Royal Rocket's hurdle debut fade when stepped up in trip suggests this shorter distance may suit him better
Both Docteur Romeo and Winning Paddy show consistent fade patterns that make them vulnerable in the finish

races.name: Royal Ascot Lunch Saturday 20 June Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Jena d'Oudairies
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has failed to impact in six recent handicaps despite dropping down the weights
runners_data.comment: Lack of impact in six handicaps, two over this sort of trip; different equipment this time
runners_data.spotlight: Down the weights but lack of impact in six handicaps (two over this sort of trip) prevents any confidence in her taking advantage; has worn tongue-tie and cheekpieces in recent starts, which are now replaced with blinkers.

runners_data.name: Lady Caro
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner with strong recent form including a win, benefits from trainer's decent 14-day strike rate

runners_data.name: Border Gem
runners_data.note: Solid prominent type with good recent placed efforts, but trainer's poor 14-day record is a concern

runners_data.name: Hurst Hill
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist returning from 163-day break but has winning form fresh and strong recent placed record

runners_data.name: Miss Tiara
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who should get first run, wearing tongue-tie and has been placed recently over similar trips

runners_data.name: Pooley's Promise
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 12lb weight advantage and coming off a recent win, wearing tongue-tie and cheekpieces

runners_data.name: Poet's Muse
runners_data.note: Second front runner but lacks recent form substance and has minimal winning experience

runners_data.name: Bee's Kiss

races.paceDynamic: Miss Tiara and Poet's Muse are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace in this 3m handicap hurdle. With two dedicated leaders, expect an honest gallop from the start that will create a searching test of stamina over this extended trip. The sustained pace will suit horses who can travel prominently and have the class to kick when it matters, while those relying on late runs from the back may find the leaders have stolen a march. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and handy types who can position close to the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the two leaders set a strong but not suicidal gallop
scenarios.body: Lady Caro and Border Gem can track the pace and have the class advantage to strike in the final half-mile. Their prominent styles are perfectly suited to capitalizing on a genuine tempo without being caught up in early speed battles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success Story
scenarios.trigger: If the leaders go too fast and compromise each other
scenarios.body: Hurst Hill benefits from his comeback fitness and hold-up style to pick up the pieces late. The long absence could be a positive given his trainer's decent strike rate and his proven ability to win from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Tiara or Poet's Muse get an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run and proves too tough to peg back over this stamina-sapping trip. Miss Tiara has the better form profile and weight-for-age allowance to make the most of tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Pooley's Promise's light weight and recent win give him an outside chance in a muddling race. The bottom weights could benefit if the race doesn't develop into a proper test of stamina.

watchPoints.text: Miss Tiara and Poet's Muse could set unsustainable fractions early and both fade, opening the door for hold-up horses
Border Gem represents a trainer with 0 wins from 11 recent runners, which undermines confidence despite the horse's solid form
Hurst Hill is having first run for 163 days but has won fresh before and could be primed for a big effort
Lady Caro relies on a 7lb claiming jockey who may struggle with tactical positioning in a small field
Pooley's Promise carries just 145lbs and could benefit significantly if the race becomes a test of stamina

races.name: Ron Hatton Memorial Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Dirty Den
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid form who faces severe traffic concerns given six horses wanting similar positions early.

runners_data.name: Bobbarelli
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old point-to-point graduate making only his second hurdles start, prominent style adds to early congestion.
runners_data.comment: Golden opportunity was missed last time; now makes handicap debut so 9yo may yet do better
runners_data.spotlight: 9yo who was 2-12 in points (the wins coming over 2m4f on good/good to firm); weakened on February's belated hurdling debut (soft) and couldn't convert what turned into a golden opportunity at Warwick (2m5f, good) four weeks ago; handicap debut and may yet do better in this sphere.

runners_data.name: Best Night
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner from powerful Pipe yard but must overcome the tactical disadvantage of crowded early positioning.

runners_data.name: Myrighthandman
runners_data.note: Another prominent type from in-form Tom Lacey stable, carries 165lbs which won't help in the anticipated positional battle.

runners_data.name: Taritino
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly positioned to capitalize on the expected prominent pace carnage, racing off just 5 days.

runners_data.name: Public Enemy
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 10lb claiming jockey James Robottom, but style puts him in the danger zone for traffic problems.

runners_data.name: Midnight Pass
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 191-day layoff, the long break adds uncertainty to her traffic-prone running style.
runners_data.comment: Encouraging third when last seen in October; new trip can suit; respected on h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Finding her feet over hurdles and October's third at Hereford (2m, good) when last seen was quite encouraging; pedigree suggests this new trip can unlock more and she's one to be interested in on this handicap debut despite the absence.

runners_data.name: Forever Penywern
runners_data.note: Sole leader type who should get uncontested fractions, 4-year-old carries minimum weight with clear tactical edge.

runners_data.name: Green Sky
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who can avoid the early scrambling, racing fresh off 5-day turnaround with clear tactical advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Forever Penywern will lead from the gates with no obvious challenger for the early pace, creating a measured tempo over this extended trip. The real battleground forms behind him where Dirty Den, Bobbarelli, Best Night, Myrighthandman, Public Enemy and Midnight Pass all want prominent positions - six horses fighting for limited real estate 3-4 wide around the home turn. This congestion will create stop-start racing and interference, while Forever Penywern enjoys a comfortable solo lead. The race shape heavily favours the leader and the two hold-up horses (Taritino and Green Sky) who can avoid the traffic carnage and pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Forever Penywern Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Forever Penywern maintains his uncontested lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old gets soft fractions throughout and has enough in reserve to repel late challenges, while the prominent pack neutralizes each other with their scrimmaging. His 150lbs bottom weight and tactical advantage prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group engages in pace-destroying tactics from the home turn
scenarios.body: Taritino and Green Sky benefit enormously from the traffic chaos ahead, sweeping past tired horses who've been battling positionally all race. The clean runs and fresher legs of the closers overwhelm a tiring leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners (likely Dirty Den or Best Night) can secure an uncontested tracking position
scenarios.body: That horse gets first run on Forever Penywern while the rest remain stuck in traffic, timing their challenge perfectly to strike 2 out. Superior fitness and tactical positioning trump raw ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Forever Penywern stops quickly and the prominent pack remains bunched entering the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy sprint finish where any of the seven prominent/midfield runners can prevail through sheer luck of avoiding trouble. Form and ratings become secondary to racing room.

watchPoints.text: Forever Penywern could get unchallenged fractions for 2+ miles if the prominent pack focuses on fighting each other rather than pressuring the leader
Traffic chaos likely 3-4 out when six prominent runners (Dirty Den, Bobbarelli, Best Night, Myrighthandman, Public Enemy, Midnight Pass) converge on limited racing room
Taritino and Green Sky as the only hold-up horses could have huge advantages if they secure clean runs through the anticipated prominent pile-up
Midnight Pass returning from 191-day absence into this tactical minefield presents significant risk for positional complications
James Robottom's 10lb claim on Public Enemy becomes crucial if the race turns into a weight-carrying contest in heavy traffic

races.paceDynamic: Mi Sueno will lead from the outset but has a concerning habit of fading in the finish, creating a moderate early gallop that shouldn't be sustainable. With 10 hold-up horses behind the single leader, this creates a perfect storm for a strong finishing kick. The lack of early pressure on Mi Sueno means the field will be bunched turning for home, setting up a cavalry charge. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses with tactical speed who can quicken off a steady pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Sueno sets his usual moderate gallop and fades as expected
scenarios.body: The 10 hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks in the straight. Class horses like Little Lady Lucy, Saucats and Portcammon can capitalise on their superior turn of foot.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Old Bridge can track Mi Sueno closely and kick when the leader weakens
scenarios.body: Being the only prominent runner gives Old Bridge tactical advantage to steal a march on the hold-up brigade. His superior rating of 100 could prove decisive if he times his move right.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mi Sueno Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Sueno finds more stamina than recent form suggests and doesn't fade
scenarios.body: His early advantage becomes insurmountable if he can resist the late challenges for once. The hold-up horses may leave their runs too late chasing a stronger pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Mi Sueno goes too slow early and stops completely, creating a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test where any horse with a turn of foot can win. Form and ratings become less relevant in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Mi Sueno's early fractions - if he goes too fast early he'll compound his finishing problems
Old Bridge's jumping after 170 days off - any early mistakes will ruin his tactical position
Little Lady Lucy's position turning for home - recent winner needs clear run to unleash her kick
The pace through halfway - if too slow the sprint finish will favour different horses entirely
Saucats and Portcammon tracking each other - stable rivals from Mulholland team could compromise each other

runners_data.name: Holeshot

runners_data.name: Sage Green
runners_data.note: Only hold-up horse facing tactical disadvantage with headgear applied, needs pace collapse to be effective

runners_data.name: Gasmani
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner fresh from a 13-day break with 3lb claimer reducing his burden, controls his own destiny

runners_data.name: Noble Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but amateur rider's 5lb claim helps offset tactical inexperience concerns

runners_data.name: Sam's Amour
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner whose recent form suggests he's past his peak at age 9

runners_data.name: Mcgregors Charge
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with significant 26lb weight advantage but much lower class than main rivals

runners_data.name: Final Entry
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 44 days off with tongue-tie applied, lacks recent race sharpness

races.paceDynamic: Gasmani looks the natural pace-setter with his prominent style and recent front-running win, likely to make the running without serious pressure. Holeshot, Noble Blue, Sam's Amour and Mcgregors Charge will all track him in the early stages, creating a decent gallop but nothing frantic. Sage Green as the sole hold-up horse will need to rely on strong finishing kick from the back. This sustainable pace strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick clear, with the hold-up horse facing a significant tactical disadvantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Gasmani Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Gasmani gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions
scenarios.body: He can use his class advantage to build a winning margin turning for home, with the trackers struggling to close the gap. His recent front-running success and highest OR of 110 makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets ideal pitch behind Gasmani
scenarios.body: They can use the solid pace to launch a telling challenge in the straight while Gasmani begins to tire. Noble Blue's recent good form and Holeshot's class make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mcgregors Charge Weight Advantage
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a stamina test over 3m
scenarios.body: His 26lb weight advantage over Gasmani becomes crucial in the final furlong as the better-weighted horses come to the fore. His recent second and win show he's in good heart.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sage Green Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The hold-up horse gets his ideal scenario to unleash a withering late run from the back of the field. His recent third shows he retains ability but needs everything to fall right.

watchPoints.text: Gasmani getting an uncontested lead - if no pressure applied early he becomes very hard to catch
Sage Green's position turning for home - needs to be much closer than usual given lack of pace angles
Charlie Maggs on Gasmani handling the pace-setting role effectively despite his 3lb claim
Noble Blue's amateur jockey Joshua Newman making key tactical decisions at crucial moments
Any signs of Mcgregors Charge traveling strongly in mid-division as his weight advantage becomes telling

races.paceDynamic: Lake Tiberias emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner in this field, with most others adopting prominent or hold-up tactics creating a tactical imbalance. The early pace will likely be modest with Lake Tiberias allowed to dictate terms unopposed, while Athena's Dream, No Mean Feat, Future Times, and Tobi Kanobee settle prominently but not aggressively. This setup creates a strong tactical advantage for horses that can travel kindly in behind and produce a sustained finish, as the lack of early pressure will leave plenty in reserve for the closing stages. The race shape clearly favors hold-up horses and those with a strong finishing kick over pure pace-setters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Tiberias sets uncontested fractions and the prominent horses don't apply early pressure
scenarios.body: The modest gallop will suit horses traveling well in behind who can unleash late runs when others have emptied their tanks. Modern Style and Peace In The Park benefit most from this patient tempo with their hold-up styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Press Forward
scenarios.trigger: If Athena's Dream and No Mean Feat decide to challenge Lake Tiberias earlier than expected
scenarios.body: A faster pace develops that will drain the stamina of front-runners but still favor those with tactical speed over pure hold-up horses. No Mean Feat and Athena's Dream can dictate the race on their terms.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lake Tiberias Dominates Gate-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner gets such soft fractions that nothing can reel him in despite the tactical setup
scenarios.body: Lake Tiberias capitalizes on the uncontested lead to build an unassailable advantage that even the closers cannot bridge. The lack of pace pressure becomes fatal for those held up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse Benefits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes so sedate that it turns into a sprint finish where any horse can win
scenarios.body: The crawling gallop nullifies class differences and allows lesser-rated horses with any finishing kick to compete. Fitness and recent form become more important than ratings.

watchPoints.text: Modern Style could be vulnerable to the quick turnaround after his recent win, watch for any signs of fatigue in preliminaries
Lake Tiberias must make his uncontested lead count as the race setup tactically favors those tracking him rather than the pace-setter
Joker Jack has pulled up multiple times recently so monitor closely for any jumping errors or signs of stopping
Peace In The Park's 11-day turnaround combined with his hold-up style makes him a key tactical player if getting the right race setup
Watch how aggressively the prominent horses position early - if they press Lake Tiberias it changes the entire complexion
